meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出一个 Emacs 通道:你可以在 Emacs 的聊天缓冲区里直接对话,也能把 org 标题或选中的文本发出去,回复作为子标题出现在原文件里。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中用键绑定(如 C-c n c)打开聊天缓冲区,或用 nanoclaw-org-send 发送 org 子树/选区时触发;需先在 .env 中设置 EMACS_ENABLED=true。

say.text: 打开 NanoClaw 聊天缓冲区
say.note: 相当于按下 C-c n c

say.text: 把当前这个 org 标题发给 NanoClaw
say.note: 回复会作为子标题插入其下

say.text: 看一下我选中的这段代码

howto.what_en: Adds an Emacs channel: an interactive chat buffer plus org-mode integration, so you can talk to NanoClaw from inside Emacs. Org sends come back as child headings in the same file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you open the chat buffer with your keybinding (e.g. C-c n c), or send an org subtree/region with nanoclaw-org-send. Requires EMACS_ENABLED=true in .env.

say_en.note: Same as pressing C-c n c

say_en.text: Send this org heading to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Reply lands as a child heading

say_en.text: Look at the code I have selected
